content: Penhulùhulù te menge Israilihanen hein Nevihag Sikandan

content.text: Nememinuu key ziyà te veyvey te menge wahig diyà te Babilonia he ebpemenineǥew hein netenuzan dey is Zion.
Impenanggat dey zà is menge alpa zey ziyà te menge subpang te kayu.
Su ibpekanta key te menge mibihag kenami.
Midsuǥù key zan te kedlangan kandan.
Ke sikandan te, “Kentahi key te kanta he mehitenged te Zion!”
Ebmenumenu key te kegkanta te kanta mehitenged te Nengazen diyà te tanà te menge mibihag kenami?
Berakat he kenè ku en mewaleng is kewanan he velad ku ke egkelipatan ku is Jerusalem!
Berakat he kenà ad mekekaǥi emun kenè ku edtentenuzan wey ed-isipen he iyan ebpekeveǥey kedì te zekelà he kelipey is Jerusalem.
Tentenuzi nu, Nengazen, is mibeelan te menge Edomnen hein mid-aǥew te menge tig-Babilonia is Jerusalem.
Migkaǥi zan te, “Purungi niw heeyan bengkaǥa.”
Sikiyu is menge meǥinged te Babilonia, edezeetan kew!
Utew zeyzey is menge etew he ebales keniyu tenged te mibeelan niw ziyà te kenami.
Utew zeyzey is egkuwa te menge anak niw ne idrumbag dan diyà te vatu.
